reviews.t: I am not a professional but like to do my own nail with gel
reviews.x: I am really impressed. I am not a professional but like to do my own nail with gel.  I never had a file like this before, just had cheapo files.  I was surprised by the power it had.  I barely had to turn it on to do what I needed.  I was surprised by how many bit it came with.  There are a ton of them.  Also there are more sanding bands that I can imagine using.  There are 100 of each grit (coarse, medium and fine).  I didn't expect much for the price and my expectations were exceeded.  I can't

This little drill comes with a ton of bits and sanding tips. Easy to use. Fairly light weight. Feels nice in my novice hand. Worth the money. I bought it to remove the bulk of gel polish of nails to reduce the soak time. I'm quite pleased with the quality and its ability thus far.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the drill powerful and effective, often noting it works like a professional tool.
Reviewers frequently praise the large number of included bits and tips and find it easy to use, even for beginners.
Several reviewers report the unit stopped working after a period of use, ranging from a few uses to about 11 months.
Some reviewers describe the drill as good value for the price and worth the money.
A few reviewers mention durability concerns or overheating, including a burning smell and a short warranty.
